description: This file defines the UtilityPaymentService class, which handles utility payment processing logic within a Spring-based microservice. It manages creating utility payment entities, invoking external REST client calls, and returning responses while updating transaction statuses.

classes.name: UtilityPaymentService
classes.description: A Spring service component responsible for processing utility payments, managing transaction states, and interfacing with the database and external REST services.

methods.name: utilPayment
methods.description: Handles the utility payment process: saves initial transaction, calls external payment API, updates transaction status, and returns a response.

methods.name: readPayments
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of utility payments, converted into DTOs for client use.
